description: Verified yaw values (degrees of rotation per mouse count at sensitivity 1.0) and default horizontal FOVs for the REDRAG Mouse Sensitivity Converter. Yaw values cross-checked against Mouse-Sensitivity.com, MouseTester.io and community testing.

games.name: Valorant
games.note: Locked 103° horizontal FOV. Sens accepts 3 decimals in GameSettings.ini.

games.name: Counter-Strike 2
games.note: Source 2 engine (m_yaw 0.022). Identical scale to CS:GO and CS 1.6.

games.name: Apex Legends
games.note: Respawn Source branch — sensitivity transfers 1:1 with CS2.

games.name: Overwatch 2
games.note: Blizzard engine. Overwatch sens x 0.3 ≈ CS2 sens.

games.name: Call of Duty: Warzone
games.note: IW engine standard at 1.00 ADS multiplier (legacy ADS mode).

games.name: Marvel Rivals
games.note: Per-hero ADS/scope multipliers are separate and not converted here.

games.name: Titanfall 2
games.note: Same Respawn Source branch as Apex Legends.

games.name: Quake Champions
games.note: Quake set the 0.022 convention Source inherited.

games.name: Rust
games.note: High yaw — sensitivity numbers are low for the same turn speed.

games.name: Escape from Tarkov
games.note: Highest yaw in the list — lowest sens numbers.

games.name: Fortnite
games.note: APPROXIMATE: percentage-based slider; build/edit modes and seasonal changes affect feel. Converted value may exceed the in-game slider — use cm/360 to verify.

games.name: Rainbow Six Siege
games.note: APPROXIMATE: hipfire baseline only. Sens interacts with FOV and the relationship has changed across patches. Set your FOV first, then convert.

games.name: PUBG: Battlegrounds
games.note: APPROXIMATE: general-sensitivity slider is non-linear and per-scope multipliers scale differently. Treat the output as a starting point.
